CREATE TABLE openalex.awards.crossref_no_doi_main_cut
USING delta
AS
WITH exploded AS (
  SELECT
    lm.work_id,
    f.doi AS funder_doi,
    f.name AS funder_name,
    f.awards AS award_ids
  FROM openalex.works.locations_mapped lm
  LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(funders) AS f
  WHERE lm.provenance = 'crossref'
    AND lm.work_id IS NOT NULL
    AND f.doi IS NOT NULL
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    e.work_id,
    -- resolve merged funders (openalex.funders.funders.merge_into_id alias rows) to the canonical id
    COALESCE(cf.merge_into_id, cf.funder_id) AS funder_id,
    e.award_ids
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN openalex.funders.funders cf ON e.funder_doi = cf.doi
  UNION ALL
  -- #1303 resolver (2026-10), LINKS ONLY: Crossref funder names with no funder id, resolved by Jev (p >= 0.9) and
  -- checked by two judges on 200 links (gate 2: 0.98-0.995). Frozen, reviewed table; recent no-funder works only.
  -- award_ids is empty on purpose: these rows add work -> funder links and never create grant records.
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.work_id,
    COALESCE(cf.merge_into_id, cf.funder_id) AS funder_id,
    CAST(array() AS ARRAY<STRING>) AS award_ids
  FROM openalex.awards.cr1303_work_funder_links_frozen l
  JOIN openalex.funders.funders cf ON cf.funder_id = l.funder_id
),
-- Explode each award_id so we can apply is_usable_award_id per-element.
-- Databricks rejects UDF calls inside higher-order functions (FILTER,
-- TRANSFORM, etc.), so we can't do FILTER(..., x -> is_usable_award_id(x)).
-- OUTER EXPLODE preserves rows where award_ids is NULL or empty, so the
-- work-funder link is kept even when no specific awards survive.
flattened AS (
  SELECT
    work_id,
    funder_id,
    CASE WHEN openalex.common.is_usable_award_id(aid) THEN aid END AS aid
  FROM matched
  LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(award_ids) AS aid
)
-- Re-aggregate one row per (work_id, funder_id). COLLECT_LIST ignores
-- NULLs, so the CASE WHEN drops junk elements naturally. ARRAY_DISTINCT
-- preserves the original dedup semantics.
SELECT
  work_id,
  funder_id,
  ARRAY_DISTINCT(COLLECT_LIST(aid)) AS award_ids
FROM flattened
GROUP BY work_id, funder_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW datacite_funder_references AS
WITH locations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT work_id, lower(native_id) AS native_id
  FROM openalex.works.locations_mapped
  WHERE provenance='datacite' AND work_id IS NOT NULL
),
raw_ranked AS (
  SELECT lower(id) AS native_id, attributes.fundingReferences AS refs,
         attributes.publisher AS publisher, ingested_at, attributes.updated AS raw_updated,
         sha2(to_json(attributes),256) AS raw_hash,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(id) ORDER BY ingested_at DESC,
           attributes.updated DESC, sha2(to_json(attributes.fundingReferences),256) DESC,
           sha2(to_json(attributes),256) DESC) AS rn
  FROM openalex.datacite.datacite_items
),
raw_refs AS (
  SELECT l.work_id, l.native_id, r.ingested_at, r.raw_updated, r.raw_hash,
         pos AS reference_index, to_json(ref) AS raw_reference,
         ref.funderIdentifier AS identifier, ref.funderIdentifierType AS declared_type,
         ref.funderName AS funder_name, ref.awardNumber AS award_number,
         ref.awardUri AS award_uri,
         lower(regexp_extract(trim(ref.funderIdentifier), r'(?i)^(?:https?://ror\.org/)?([0-9a-z]{9})/?$',1)) AS rk,
         CASE WHEN upper(trim(r.publisher.publisherIdentifierScheme))='ROR'
           THEN nullif(lower(regexp_extract(trim(r.publisher.publisherIdentifier), r'(?i)^(?:https?://ror\.org/)?([0-9a-z]{9})/?$',1)),'') END AS publisher_ror
  FROM locations l JOIN raw_ranked r ON r.native_id=l.native_id AND r.rn=1
  LATERAL VIEW posexplode(r.refs) e AS pos, ref
)
SELECT *,sha2(to_json(named_struct('native_id',native_id,'name',funder_name,'ror',rk,'award_number',award_number,'award_uri',award_uri)),256) reference_key FROM raw_refs

WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM registry_seed_funders),
r AS (
  SELECT a.funder_id,
    CASE WHEN a.merge_into_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.merge_into_id IS NULL THEN a.merge_into_id

rorx AS (

    array_distinct(filter(transform(flatten(transform(filter(coalesce(external_ids, array()), e -> lower(e.type) = 'fundref'),

  FROM openalex.institutions.ror
),
live AS (
  SELECT v.funder_id, CAST(v.crossref_id AS STRING) fr, lower(regexp_extract(v.ror_id, '([0-9a-z]{9})/*$', 1)) rid, regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(v.display_name), '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '') dn, coalesce(w.works_count, 0) works,

  FROM v LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, works_count FROM openalex.funders.funders_api) w ON w.id = v.funder_id
  WHERE v.merge_into_id IS NULL AND nullif(v.ror_id, '') IS NOT NULL
),
shared AS (SELECT rid FROM live GROUP BY rid HAVING count(*) > 1),
mem AS (
  SELECT l.*, coalesce(true AND array_contains(x.fundrefs, l.fr), false) in_xw, coalesce(array_contains(x.nk, l.dn), false) exact,
    coalesce(arrays_overlap(l.nk, x.nk), false) name_ok
  FROM live l JOIN shared s ON s.rid = l.rid LEFT JOIN rorx x ON x.rid = l.rid
),

best AS (SELECT rid, min(t) bt FROM tier GROUP BY rid),
keep AS (SELECT t.rid, max_by(t.funder_id, t.works * 10000000000 - t.funder_id) keeper, count(*) n_at, max(b.bt) bt
         FROM tier t JOIN best b ON b.rid = t.rid AND t.t = b.bt WHERE b.bt < 9 GROUP BY t.rid),

    CASE WHEN (k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4)) AND m.funder_id = k.keeper THEN 'PRIMARY_SHARED_ROR'
         WHEN k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4) THEN 'SECONDARY_SHARED_ROR' ELSE 'NO_ATTACH_SHARED_ROR_TIE' END d,
    coalesce((k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4)) AND m.funder_id <> k.keeper AND m.exact, false) merge_candidate
  FROM tier m LEFT JOIN keep k ON k.rid = m.rid
)

      e -> coalesce(e.all, array()))), x -> regexp_extract(trim(x), '^(?:(?:https?://)?(?:dx\\.)?(?:doi\\.org/)?10\\.13039/)?([0-9]{5,})$', 1)), x -> x <> '')) fundrefs,
    array_distinct(filter(transform(coalesce(transform(filter(coalesce(names, array()), n -> NOT array_contains(n.types, 'acronym')), n -> n.value), array()), x -> regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(x), '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '')), x -> length(x) >= 4)) nk
  FROM openalex.institutions.ror
),
live AS (
  SELECT v.funder_id, CAST(v.crossref_id AS STRING) fr, lower(regexp_extract(v.ror_id, '([0-9a-z]{9})/*$', 1)) rid, regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(v.display_name), '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '') dn, coalesce(w.works_count, 0) works,
    array_distinct(filter(transform(coalesce(concat(array(v.display_name), coalesce(from_json(v.alternate_titles, 'array<string>'), array())), array()), x -> regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(x), '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '')), x -> length(x) >= 4)) nk
  FROM v LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, works_count FROM openalex.funders.funders_api) w ON w.id = v.funder_id
  WHERE v.merge_into_id IS NULL AND nullif(v.ror_id, '') IS NOT NULL
),
shared AS (SELECT rid FROM live GROUP BY rid HAVING count(*) > 1),
mem AS (
  SELECT l.*, coalesce(true AND array_contains(x.fundrefs, l.fr), false) in_xw, coalesce(array_contains(x.nk, l.dn), false) exact,
    coalesce(arrays_overlap(l.nk, x.nk), false) name_ok
  FROM live l JOIN shared s ON s.rid = l.rid LEFT JOIN rorx x ON x.rid = l.rid
),
tier AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN in_xw AND exact THEN 1 WHEN in_xw AND name_ok THEN 2 WHEN in_xw THEN 3 WHEN exact THEN 4
                        WHEN name_ok THEN 5 ELSE 9 END t FROM mem),
best AS (SELECT rid, min(t) bt FROM tier GROUP BY rid),
keep AS (SELECT t.rid, max_by(t.funder_id, t.works * 10000000000 - t.funder_id) keeper, count(*) n_at, max(b.bt) bt
         FROM tier t JOIN best b ON b.rid = t.rid AND t.t = b.bt WHERE b.bt < 9 GROUP BY t.rid),
shared_dec AS (
  SELECT m.funder_id, m.rid, m.t, k.keeper, coalesce(k.bt, 9) bt,
    CASE WHEN (k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4)) AND m.funder_id = k.keeper THEN 'PRIMARY_SHARED_ROR'
         WHEN k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4) THEN 'SECONDARY_SHARED_ROR' ELSE 'NO_ATTACH_SHARED_ROR_TIE' END d,
    coalesce((k.n_at = 1 OR k.bt IN (1, 4)) AND m.funder_id <> k.keeper AND m.exact, false) merge_candidate
  FROM tier m LEFT JOIN keep k ON k.rid = m.rid
)
SELECT 'openalex_v41', CAST(v.funder_id AS STRING), v.display_name, from_json(v.alternate_titles, 'array<string>'), v.country_code,
  nullif(v.ror_id, ''), CASE WHEN v.crossref_id IS NOT NULL THEN array(CAST(v.crossref_id AS STRING)) END,
  CASE WHEN v.merge_into_id IS NOT NULL THEN array(CAST(v.merge_into_id AS STRING)) END,
  CASE WHEN v.merge_into_id IS NULL THEN 'active' ELSE 'merged' END, true, v.homepage_url,
  to_json(struct(v.*), map('timestampFormat', "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSXXX")),   -- microseconds, so the compat passthrough reproduces v41 exactly
  sha2(to_json(struct(v.*)), 256), current_timestamp(), current_timestamp(), ('fd' || 'cutover_20261011'),
  CASE WHEN s.d = 'NO_ATTACH_SHARED_ROR_TIE' THEN 'not_attached' ELSE 'accepted' END,
  CASE WHEN s.d IS NOT NULL THEN s.d || CASE WHEN s.merge_candidate THEN ' (MERGE_CANDIDATE into F' || s.keeper || ')' ELSE '' END END,
  coalesce(r.root, v.funder_id), ('fd' || 'cutover_20261011'), CAST(NULL AS STRING)
FROM v JOIN r ON r.funder_id = v.funder_id LEFT JOIN shared_dec s ON s.funder_id = v.funder_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW openalex.funders.resolution_keys AS
WITH acronym_keys AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(nm), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '') k FROM openalex.funders.funder f
 LATERAL VIEW explode(coalesce(f.alt_names,array())) a AS nm
 WHERE trim(nm) RLIKE '^[A-Z]{1,5}$'
), acronym_keeps AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(a.name), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '') keep_key,try_cast(regexp_extract(a.id,'F([0-9]+)$',1) AS BIGINT) keep_id
 FROM openalex.common.funder_names_keep a WHERE upper(trim(a.keep))='YES'
), candidates AS (
 SELECT i.id_type key_type, i.id_value key_value, e.canonical_id funder_id,
        coalesce(i.origin_funder_id,i.funder_id) origin_funder_id
 FROM openalex.funders.funder_id i JOIN openalex.funders.reader_entities e ON e.funder_id=i.funder_id
 WHERE (i.id_type IN ('fundref','name') OR (i.id_type='ror' AND i.is_primary)) AND e.canonical_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (i.id_type='fundref' AND e.registry_created)
 UNION ALL
 -- Include all names, not just the unique index, so collisions cannot be hidden.
 SELECT 'name', regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(nm), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', ''), e.canonical_id, f.funder_id
 FROM openalex.funders.funder f JOIN openalex.funders.reader_entities e ON e.funder_id=f.funder_id
 LATERAL VIEW explode(concat(array(f.display_name), coalesce(f.alt_names,array()))) n AS nm
 WHERE e.canonical_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 -- Preserve DataCite's exact-name conflict guard independently of normalized aliases.
 SELECT 'exact_name', lower(trim(nm)), e.canonical_id, f.funder_id
 FROM openalex.funders.funder f JOIN openalex.funders.reader_entities e ON e.funder_id=f.funder_id
 LATERAL VIEW explode(concat(array(f.display_name), coalesce(f.alt_names,array()))) n AS nm
 WHERE e.canonical_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'name', regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(a.name), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', ''), e.canonical_id, e.funder_id
 FROM openalex.common.funder_names_keep a JOIN openalex.funders.reader_entities e
 ON e.funder_id=try_cast(regexp_extract(a.id,'F([0-9]+)$',1) AS BIGINT)
 WHERE upper(trim(a.keep))='YES' AND e.canonical_id IS NOT NULL
), scoped AS (
 SELECT key_type,key_value,funder_id,'all' name_policy FROM candidates
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.key_type,c.key_value,c.funder_id,'datacite_name_v1' FROM candidates c
 LEFT SEMI JOIN openalex.funders.funder_match_policy p ON p.funder_id=c.origin_funder_id AND p.matcher='datacite_name_v1' AND p.eligible
 WHERE c.key_type IN ('name','exact_name')
)
SELECT key_type,key_value,name_policy,count(DISTINCT funder_id) owners,max(funder_id) funder_id
FROM scoped
LEFT JOIN acronym_keys excluded ON key_type IN ('name','exact_name') AND key_value=excluded.k
LEFT JOIN acronym_keeps kept ON key_value=kept.keep_key AND funder_id=kept.keep_id
WHERE key_value IS NOT NULL AND key_value<>'' AND (excluded.k IS NULL OR kept.keep_id IS NOT NULL)
AND NOT (key_type IN ('name','exact_name') AND (
 (key_value='robert bosch germany' AND funder_id=4320325119)
 OR (key_value='council of scientific and industrial research csir' AND funder_id=3825135565)
 OR (key_value='national health service' AND funder_id=3458447014)))
GROUP BY key_type,key_value,name_policy;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openalex.funders.resolve_funder(
 funder_name STRING, ror STRING, fundref STRING, internal_key BOOLEAN, requested_name_policy STRING)
RETURNS TABLE(funder_id BIGINT, reason STRING, ror_owners BIGINT, fundref_owners BIGINT,
 name_owners BIGINT, ror_funder_id BIGINT, fundref_funder_id BIGINT, name_funder_id BIGINT,
 exact_name_owners BIGINT, exact_name_funder_id BIGINT)
RETURN
WITH input AS (
 SELECT regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(lower(funder_name), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' ')), '^the ', '') nk,
 lower(regexp_extract(trim(ror), r'(?i)^(?:https?://ror\.org/)?([0-9a-z]{9})/?$',1)) rk,
 regexp_extract(trim(fundref), r'(?i)^(?:(?:https?://(?:dx\.)?doi\.org/|doi:\s*)?10\.13039/)?([0-9]+)$',1) fk
), hits AS (
 SELECT r.owners rc,r.funder_id rf,d.owners dc,d.funder_id df,n.owners nc,n.funder_id nf,e.owners ec,e.funder_id ef
 FROM input x
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.resolution_keys r ON r.key_type='ror' AND r.name_policy='all' AND r.key_value=x.rk
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.resolution_keys d ON d.key_type='fundref' AND d.name_policy='all' AND d.key_value=x.fk AND internal_key
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.resolution_keys n ON n.key_type='name' AND n.name_policy=requested_name_policy AND n.key_value=x.nk
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.resolution_keys e ON e.key_type='exact_name' AND e.name_policy=requested_name_policy AND e.key_value=lower(trim(funder_name))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN rc=1 THEN rf WHEN dc=1 THEN df WHEN nc=1 THEN nf END,
 CASE WHEN rc=1 THEN 'ROR' WHEN dc=1 THEN 'FundRef internal' WHEN nc=1 THEN 'name'
      WHEN rc>1 OR dc>1 OR nc>1 THEN 'ambiguous' ELSE 'unresolved' END,
 rc,dc,nc,rf,df,nf,ec,ef FROM hits;

CREATE TABLE openalex.funders.funders_api_cutover_check AS
WITH
-- Base from funders array (for work-funder relationships)
wf_base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(REPLACE(funder.id, 'https://openalex.org/F', '') AS BIGINT) AS funder_id,
    CAST(w.id AS BIGINT) AS work_id
  FROM openalex.works.openalex_works w
  LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(w.funders) AS funder
  WHERE funder.id IS NOT NULL 
    AND w.id IS NOT NULL
    AND funder.id LIKE 'https://openalex.org/F%'
),
-- Enrich with work-level signals needed for metrics
wf_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    b.funder_id,
    b.work_id,
    COALESCE(w.publication_year, YEAR(w.publication_date)) AS pub_year,
    CAST(w.cited_by_count AS INT) AS cited_by_count,
    CAST(w.open_access.is_oa AS BOOLEAN) AS is_oa
  FROM wf_base b
  JOIN openalex.works.openalex_works w
    ON w.id = b.work_id
),
funder_unique_awards AS (
  SELECT
    funder_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unique_awards_count
  FROM openalex.awards.openalex_awards
  WHERE funder_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY funder_id
),
-- Per-funder metrics (works, citations, OA, grants; plus helpers for summary_stats)
funder_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    funder_id,
    /* counts over unique works */
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT work_id) AS INT) AS works_count,
    CAST(SUM(cited_by_count) AS INT)     AS cited_by_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_oa THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INT) AS oa_works_count,
    /* summary_stats helpers */
    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN pub_year >= YEAR(current_date()) - 2 THEN cited_by_count END) AS DOUBLE) AS two_year_mean,
    CAST(COUNT_IF(cited_by_count >= 10) AS INT) AS i10_index,
    SORT_ARRAY(
      TRANSFORM(
        FILTER(COLLECT_LIST(cited_by_count), x -> x IS NOT NULL),
        x -> CAST(x AS INT)
      ),
      false
    ) AS sorted_citations
  FROM wf_enriched
  GROUP BY funder_id
),
-- Funder Roles CTE
funder_roles AS (
  WITH entity_links_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
      f.funder_id AS funder_id,
      el.id_1,
      el.id_2
    FROM openalex.funders.funders f
    INNER JOIN openalex.mid.entity_link el 
      ON (el.id_1 = CONCAT('F', f.funder_id) OR el.id_2 = CONCAT('F', f.funder_id))
  ),
  all_entity_ids AS (
    -- Funder's own role
    SELECT 
      f.funder_id AS funder_id,
      CONCAT('F', f.funder_id) AS entity_id,
      'funder' AS role
    FROM openalex.funders.funders f
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Linked institution/publisher roles
    SELECT 
      funder_id,
      CASE 
        WHEN id_1 LIKE 'F%' THEN id_2 
        ELSE id_1 
      END AS entity_id,
      CASE 
        WHEN id_1 LIKE 'I%' OR id_2 LIKE 'I%' THEN 'institution'
        WHEN id_1 LIKE 'P%' OR id_2 LIKE 'P%' THEN 'publisher'
      END AS role
    FROM entity_links_expanded
    WHERE (id_1 LIKE 'I%' OR id_1 LIKE 'P%' OR id_2 LIKE 'I%' OR id_2 LIKE 'P%')
  ),
  roles_with_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      ae.funder_id,
      ae.role,
      CONCAT('https://openalex.org/', ae.entity_id) AS id,
      CASE 
        -- For funder: use works_count from funder_metrics
        WHEN ae.role = 'funder' THEN fm.works_count
        -- For institution: join to institutions_api table
        WHEN ae.role = 'institution' THEN i_api.works_count
        -- For publisher: join to publishers_api table
        WHEN ae.role = 'publisher' THEN p_api.works_count
      END AS works_count
    FROM all_entity_ids ae
    -- Join to funder_metrics for funder works_count
    LEFT JOIN funder_metrics fm 
      ON ae.role = 'funder' AND ae.funder_id = fm.funder_id
    -- Join to institutions_api for institution works_count
    LEFT JOIN openalex.institutions.institutions_api i_api
      ON ae.role = 'institution' AND ae.entity_id = CONCAT('I', i_api.id)
    -- Join to publishers_api for publisher works_count
    LEFT JOIN openalex.publishers.publishers_api p_api
      ON ae.role = 'publisher' AND ae.entity_id = CONCAT('P', p_api.id)
  ),
  deduplicated_roles AS (
    SELECT 
      funder_id,
      role,
      id,
      CAST(COALESCE(works_count, 0) AS INT) AS works_count,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY funder_id, role 
        ORDER BY works_count DESC, id
      ) AS rn
    FROM roles_with_counts
  )
  SELECT 
    funder_id,
    COLLECT_LIST(
      STRUCT(role, id, works_count)
    ) AS roles
  FROM deduplicated_roles
  WHERE rn = 1  -- Keep only one per role type
  GROUP BY funder_id
)

SELECT
  f.funder_id AS id,
  f.display_name,
  from_json(f.alternate_titles, 'ARRAY<STRING>') AS alternate_titles,
  f.country_code,
  f.description,
  f.homepage_url,
  f.image_url,
  f.image_thumbnail_url,
  STRUCT(
    CONCAT('https://openalex.org/F', f.funder_id) AS openalex,
    f.ror_id       AS ror,
    f.wikidata_id  AS wikidata,
    f.crossref_id  AS crossref,
    f.doi          AS doi
  ) AS ids,

  /* totals */
  COALESCE(m.works_count, 0)      AS works_count,
  COALESCE(m.cited_by_count, 0)   AS cited_by_count,
  COALESCE(fua.unique_awards_count, 0) AS awards_count,

  -- Roles
  COALESCE(fr.roles, ARRAY()) AS roles,

  /* counts_by_year */
  (
    SELECT
      SORT_ARRAY(
        COLLECT_LIST(
          STRUCT(
            year,
            works_count,
            oa_works_count,
            cited_by_count
          )
        ),
        false
      )
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(e.pub_year AS INT) AS year,
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT e.work_id) AS INT) AS works_count,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_oa THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INT) AS oa_works_count,
        CAST(SUM(e.cited_by_count) AS INT) AS cited_by_count
      FROM wf_enriched e
      WHERE e.funder_id = f.funder_id
        AND e.pub_year IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY CAST(e.pub_year AS INT)
    )
  ) AS counts_by_year,

  /* summary_stats */
  NAMED_STRUCT(
    '2yr_mean_citedness', COALESCE(m.two_year_mean, 0.0),
    'h_index',
      CAST(
        ARRAY_MAX(
          ZIP_WITH(
            m.sorted_citations,
            SEQUENCE(1, SIZE(m.sorted_citations)),
            (citation, rank) -> IF(citation >= rank, rank, 0)
          )
        ) AS INT
      ),
    'i10_index', COALESCE(m.i10_index, 0)
  ) AS summary_stats,

  /* dates */
  DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', CAST(f.created_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS created_date,
  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_date

FROM openalex.funders.funders f
LEFT JOIN funder_metrics m
  ON m.funder_id = f.funder_id
LEFT JOIN funder_unique_awards fua
  ON f.funder_id = fua.funder_id
LEFT JOIN funder_roles fr ON f.funder_id = fr.funder_id
-- merge losers (MergeFunders.ipynb alias rows) stay in openalex.funders.funders so DOI/name
-- matching keeps resolving, but must not surface as API entities
WHERE f.merge_into_id IS NULL;

-- name_lookup: ROR/exact remain ahead of hierarchy, reviewed aliases, twins, programmes.
-- All-ROR names and broad normalization are ONLY used for pipe-delimited leaves.
-- No country/fuzzy matching and no nm1012_jev_* inputs: Jev requires a new gate.
CREATE TABLE openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_lookup_rows AS
WITH f AS (SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN m.loser_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.funder_id
 ELSE coalesce(f.merge_into_id,f.funder_id) END canonical_id
 FROM openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_catalogue_after f
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_merges m ON m.loser_id=f.funder_id),
alias_variants AS (
 SELECT canonical_id,lower(trim(nm)) k FROM f
 LATERAL VIEW explode(array_union(array(display_name),coalesce(from_json(alternate_titles,'array<string>'),array()))) a AS nm
), aliases AS (SELECT k,array_sort(collect_set(canonical_id)) targets FROM alias_variants WHERE k<>'' GROUP BY k),
keep_variants AS (
 SELECT f.canonical_id,lower(trim(k.name)) k FROM openalex.common.funder_names_keep k
 JOIN f ON f.funder_id=try_cast(regexp_extract(k.id,'([0-9]+)$',1) AS BIGINT)
), keeps AS (SELECT k,array_sort(collect_set(canonical_id)) targets FROM keep_variants WHERE k<>'' GROUP BY k),
names AS (
 SELECT k,targets FROM keeps
 UNION ALL SELECT a.k,a.targets FROM aliases a LEFT ANTI JOIN keeps k ON a.k=k.k
),
prod_ror_variants AS (
 SELECT canonical_id,lower(regexp_extract(trim(ror_id),r'(?i)^(?:https?://ror\.org/)?([0-9a-z]{9})/?$',1)) k FROM f
), registry_ror_variants AS (
 SELECT coalesce(f.canonical_id,r.funder_id) canonical_id,lower(regexp_extract(trim(r.id_value),r'(?i)^(?:https?://ror\.org/)?([0-9a-z]{9})/?$',1)) k
 FROM openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_identifiers r
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_merges tm ON tm.loser_id=r.origin_funder_id
 LEFT JOIN f ON f.funder_id=CASE WHEN tm.loser_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.origin_funder_id ELSE r.funder_id END WHERE r.id_type='ror'
), ror_variants AS (
 SELECT * FROM registry_ror_variants
 UNION ALL
 SELECT p.* FROM prod_ror_variants p LEFT ANTI JOIN registry_ror_variants r ON p.k=r.k
), rors AS (SELECT k,array_sort(collect_set(canonical_id)) targets FROM ror_variants WHERE k<>'' GROUP BY k),
-- (i) Every ROR name type is retained for candidate construction. A single
-- globally unique target is required. Standalone all-ROR matching failed 99%.
ror_names AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(n.value)) k,target funder_id
 FROM openalex.institutions.ror x JOIN rors r
 ON lower(regexp_extract(x.id,'([0-9a-z]{9})/*$',1))=r.k
 LATERAL VIEW explode(x.names) a AS n LATERAL VIEW explode(r.targets) b AS target
 WHERE trim(n.value)<>''
), dictionary AS (
 SELECT k,target funder_id FROM names LATERAL VIEW explode(targets) e AS target
 UNION ALL SELECT k,funder_id FROM ror_names
), normalized_variants AS (
 -- (ii) This normalization is used for hierarchy leaves only in the accepted
 -- ladder. Applying it to arbitrary whole strings failed the 99% criterion.
 SELECT trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(translate(lower(replace(replace(replace(k,'&','&'),''',char(39)),''',char(39))), 'áàâäãåāăąçćčďđéèêëēėęěíìîïīıłñńňóòôöõøōőřśšşťúùûüūůűýÿžźż', 'aaaaaaaaacccddeeeeeeeeiiiiiilnnnoooooooorssstuuuuuuuyyzzz'), '&', ' and '), r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', ' '), r'(^| )the( |$)', ' ')) nk,funder_id FROM dictionary
), normalized_names AS (
 SELECT nk,collect_set(funder_id) targets FROM normalized_variants
 WHERE length(nk)>=4 GROUP BY nk
),
twin_names AS (
 SELECT n.k,collect_set(coalesce(m.survivor_id,t)) targets,count_if(m.loser_id IS NOT NULL) changed
 FROM (SELECT k,explode(targets) t FROM names) n
 LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_merges m ON m.loser_id=t
 GROUP BY n.k
), unique_rules AS (
 SELECT 'exact' rule,k name_key,get(targets,0) funder_id FROM names WHERE size(targets)=1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'hierarchy',nk,get(targets,0) FROM normalized_names WHERE size(targets)=1
 UNION ALL SELECT rule,name_key,funder_id FROM openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_aliases
 UNION ALL SELECT 'twin',k,get(targets,0) FROM twin_names WHERE size(targets)=1 AND changed>0
)
SELECT u.rule,u.name_key,coalesce(f.merge_into_id,f.funder_id) funder_id
FROM unique_rules u
JOIN openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_catalogue_after f ON f.funder_id=u.funder_id
JOIN openalex.funders.nm1013_integrated_catalogue_after target ON target.funder_id=coalesce(f.merge_into_id,f.funder_id)
WHERE target.merge_into_id IS NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE openalex.funders.funders_compat AS
SELECT f.funder_id, CAST(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.crossref_id') AS BIGINT) crossref_id,
  get_json_object(v41.j, '$.location') location, f.display_name,
  CASE WHEN CASE WHEN v41.j IS NULL AND r.source_key IS NOT NULL THEN array_sort(array_distinct(concat(coalesce(f.alt_names, array()), coalesce(r.alt_names, array())))) ELSE f.alt_names END <=> from_json(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.alternate_titles'), 'array<string>') THEN get_json_object(v41.j, '$.alternate_titles') ELSE to_json(coalesce(CASE WHEN v41.j IS NULL AND r.source_key IS NOT NULL THEN array_sort(array_distinct(concat(coalesce(f.alt_names, array()), coalesce(r.alt_names, array())))) ELSE f.alt_names END, array())) END alternate_titles,
  get_json_object(v41.j, '$.uri') uri,
  coalesce(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.replaces'), CASE WHEN v41.j IS NULL THEN '[]' END) replaces,
  coalesce(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.replaced_by'), CASE WHEN v41.j IS NULL THEN '[]' END) replaced_by,
  get_json_object(v41.j, '$.tokens') tokens, CASE WHEN v41.j IS NOT NULL THEN get_json_object(v41.j, '$.ror_id') ELSE f.ror_id END ror_id,
  CASE WHEN f.status = 'merged' THEN f.merged_into_id END merge_into_id,
  CASE WHEN v41.j IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.merge_into_date') AS TIMESTAMP) WHEN f.status='merged' THEN f.updated_date END merge_into_date,
  coalesce(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.created_date'), CAST(f.created_date AS STRING)) created_date, f.wikidata_id,
  get_json_object(v41.j, '$.doi') doi,
  f.country_code, f.homepage_url, f.description, f.image_url, f.image_thumbnail_url, get_json_object(v41.j, '$.json_entity_hash') json_entity_hash, CASE WHEN v41.j IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(get_json_object(v41.j, '$.updated_date') AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE f.updated_date END updated_date
FROM openalex.funders.funder f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(source_key AS BIGINT) funder_id, record_json j FROM openalex.funders.funder_source_record WHERE source = 'openalex_v41') v41 ON v41.funder_id = f.funder_id
LEFT JOIN openalex.funders.funder_source_record r ON r.source = 'ror' AND r.source_key = lower(regexp_extract(f.ror_id, '([0-9a-z]{9})/*$', 1)) AND r.record_status <> 'gone'
WHERE f.status IN ('active', 'merged');
